baseline_models.focus_anchor: مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَمُهَيْمِنًا عَلَيْهِ
baseline_models.mechanism: The new Book realizes the truth claim of the earlier Book and stands over it as an attending witness and caretaker; confirmation and supervision form one operation.

activation_trace.role: Realizing a claim in action makes confirmation active rather than merely verbal.
Witnessing joined to care supplies the supervisory relation to the earlier Book.
The repeated written Book is the textual object whose continuity is attested and guarded.

changed_reading.before: The new Book simply agrees with prior scripture and outranks it.
changed_reading.after: It actively verifies prior scripture while serving as its witnessing caretaker and supervisory standard.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَهُم ... وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ عَمَّا جَآءَكَ مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ
baseline_models.mechanism: Judgment acts like a rein: it blocks an adjudicator from tracking inclinations down a falling trajectory and keeps movement aligned with arrived, stable truth.

activation_trace.role: The restraining rein gives judgment a directional-control function.
Tracing an effect step by step models how preference can become a followed course.
Falling into a drop supplies the dangerous direction latent in self-inclination.
Stable correspondence to reality is the fixed line toward which judgment is reined.

changed_reading.before: Judge with revealed propositions and disregard personal preferences.
changed_reading.after: Use revealed truth to govern the trajectory of judgment, braking the stepwise descent produced by followed inclinations.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: لِكُلٍّ جَعَلْنَا مِنكُمْ شِرْعَةً وَمِنْهَاجًا ... لِّيَبْلُوَكُمْ فِى مَآ ءَاتَىٰكُمْ فَٱسْتَبِقُوا ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ
baseline_models.mechanism: Each community is constituted with an accessible watercourse and a manifest road. The differentiated gift is the material of an assay, while the shared motion is advance toward what benefits.

activation_trace.role: Making something into a state marks communal differentiation as an assigned condition.
A visible water source renders each law an access point from which life and action can proceed.
A clearly disclosed road gives the allotted course practical traversability.
Testing that makes a condition appear turns difference into disclosed performance.
The split mapping likewise presents trial as the event that reveals actual condition.
Giving makes each route part of a received endowment rather than a self-invented exception.
Advancing in a race supplies common forward motion without requiring one identical track.
Beneficial good names the shared direction by the fruit of movement rather than route identity.

changed_reading.before: Communities have different codes, and all are simply told to do good.
changed_reading.after: God assigns distinct usable routes inside received gifts as the assay itself, then gives them a common forward criterion in beneficial outcomes.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: لَجَعَلَكُمْ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً ... إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ جَمِيعًا فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: Present plurality is not repaired by manufacturing one community. All routes converge through collective return, where an authoritative report discloses the differences that remain unresolved in history.

activation_trace.role: A community or kind supplies the collective unit God could have made uniform.
Making one names the unrealized alternative of imposed uniformity.
Return to the point of origin supplies the actual site of convergence.
Completion without remainder makes the return collective despite present separation.
A consequential report makes final disclosure, rather than present coercion, resolve the record.
Taking different paths names the unresolved divergence gathered for later disclosure.

changed_reading.before: Religious difference is a temporary defect that human judgment should remove by producing one community.
changed_reading.after: Distinct routes remain live in the present; convergence belongs to collective return and divine disclosure, not forced historical sameness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Torah sequence joins entrusted preservation to being witnesses over the Book. That pair supplies an institutional grammar for the focus Book's role as muhaymin: it both keeps watch and gives accountable testimony.

activation_trace.role: Guarding through sustained care supplies the preservation half of scriptural custody.
Presence with observation supplies the accountable witness half of custody.
Witnessing and care combine the two contextual functions in the focus supervisory term.
Active realization makes custody verify the earlier Book rather than merely store it.

structural_cues: 5:44 places entrusted preservation and witness immediately within the repeated revelation-and-judgment sequence that culminates in 5:48.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies preservation plus witness before a focus branch that fuses witness with care; I infer functional continuity at a higher scriptural level. A more asymmetric sense of sovereign criterion remains live.

changed_reading.before: Muhaymin chiefly signals that the new Book dominates or replaces prior scripture.
changed_reading.after: Muhaymin also names accountable custody continuous with the pericope's preservation-and-witness pairing, even while the new Book judges the record.

context_deltas.mechanism: Corruption in 5:41 is represented as meaningful words being inclined away from their placements. The focus then presents revelation as proper placement, truth as a fitted joint, and the Book as overseer, yielding a positional model of textual integrity.

activation_trace.role: Inclining away from a direction supplies the displacement operation that corrupts.
The meaningful verbal unit is the material whose relation is displaced.
A fixed or assigned placement supplies the relation from which words are moved.
Putting a thing in its proper station turns revelation into a corrective placement act.
Truth fitting its joint or receptacle makes right relation part of textual truth.
Watchful care makes the new Book monitor whether the inherited words remain rightly situated.

structural_cues: 5:41 locates distortion after the words' placements; 5:48 repeats Book, truth, revelation, and oversight as one tightly linked complex.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deflection, meaningful words, fixed positions, proper placement, and fitting truth; I infer that supervision audits relations and context as well as lexical content. The live alternative is that the displacement language refers only to changed meaning.

changed_reading.before: The overseeing Book tests whether inherited statements are individually true.
changed_reading.after: It also tests whether words remain in their assigned textual and legal relations; displacement can falsify a record even when tokens remain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding legal sequence moves from preserving life through deterrent restraint to explicit repair, then requires a straight balance in judgment. It activates the focus branch of hukm as prevention and return for correction, not sanction alone.

activation_trace.role: Keeping life and refraining from killing supplies the protective horizon of law.
A penalty that restrains others gives sanction a preventive function.
Repair opposed to corruption keeps restoration open after wrongdoing.
A straight balance supplies the measured form required of judicial restraint.
Preventing and turning back for repair integrates protection, deterrence, balance, and reform.

structural_cues: 5:32-42 sequences life preservation, sanction, repentance with repair, and balanced judgment before the focus repeats the command to judge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the sequence and each functional branch; I infer a purpose arrow from judgment to harm prevention and restored measure. Retribution remains a materially live function alongside restoration.

changed_reading.before: Judging by revelation primarily means applying disclosed sanctions correctly.
changed_reading.after: It is a harm-stopping and measure-restoring practice whose sanctions deter, whose horizon is life, and whose process leaves repair possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pericope opens with parallel offerings but unequal acceptance, then follows the focus by warning against being bent away from part of revelation. These flanks distinguish divinely allotted route difference from appetite-driven selection within a received route.

activation_trace.role: An offering that seeks nearness supplies a shared ritual field in which responses can still differ.
Acceptance with approval makes the shared act evaluable rather than automatically equivalent.
Bending someone away from truth supplies the pressure that creates illegitimate deviation.
Partitive division makes selective subtraction from what was given visible.
The allotted access point anchors legitimate differentiation in divine provision.
An assay that reveals condition makes conduct within difference answerable.
The alternate mapped inventory confirms trial as disclosure rather than blanket approval.

structural_cues: 5:27 gives one paired ritual with asymmetric acceptance, while 5:49 repeats the focus prohibition and warns specifically against partial deflection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assigned routes, testing, asymmetric acceptance, and pressure toward partial revelation; I infer a boundary between legitimate plurality and self-serving subtraction. The opening offering scene may instead address piety without directly modeling communal difference.

changed_reading.before: Different divinely assigned paths make all path choices or performances equivalent.
changed_reading.after: Assigned difference is itself an assay: enacted response can be accepted or rejected, and selective subtraction under pressure is not legitimate plurality.

context_deltas.mechanism: On both sides of the focus, rapid movement runs toward disbelief or fear-based affiliation. The command to race does not praise speed by itself; it redirects anxious competitive energy toward beneficial goods.

activation_trace.role: Speed opposed to slowness supplies a pre-focus rush whose object is corrupting.
The repeated speed supplies a post-focus rush into protective affiliation.
Departure from sound balance identifies the inner condition driving the rush.
A feared adverse turn or defeat supplies the anticipated event that accelerates affiliation.
Advancing in a race preserves urgency while changing its direction and object.
Beneficial good becomes the criterion that distinguishes a race from a diseased rush.

structural_cues: The focus imperative to race is bracketed by rushing in 5:41 and 5:52, with the latter explicitly driven by fear of a reversal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three speed scenes and their contrasting objects; I infer that the focus imperative redirects rather than merely intensifies motion. The speed recurrences may be thematic contrast rather than a deliberate lexical frame.

changed_reading.before: Race to good means outperforming other communities on their competing tracks.
changed_reading.after: It redirects fear-driven and factional haste; the decisive issue is the direction and fruit of urgency, not victory over another community.

context_deltas.mechanism: Extended-path language appears before and after the focus, then prayer, purifying growth, and humble bending make the route bodily and social. The good things are visible ways of traversing an allotment, not an abstract scoreboard.

activation_trace.role: An extended traversable road supplies the pre-focus movement toward God.
The repeated road supplies a post-focus field in which committed exertion is enacted.
Specific worship makes one segment of the traversed good ritually visible.
The split mapping's obligatory worship reinforces prayer as sustained route practice.
Purity and repair give transfer of wealth a transforming social fruit.
Humble lowering gives the route an embodied posture rather than only a legal label.
The visible source supplies an allotted point of practical access.
The clear road binds the surrounding path language into the focus allotment.
Beneficial good names the fruit by which these enacted route practices are read.

structural_cues: A path to God in 5:35 and striving in God's path in 5:54 bracket the focus route language; 5:55 immediately renders affiliation through repeated practices.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies road imagery and the practice cluster; I infer that these practices exemplify the focus goods and make the route traversable. They may instead define the nearby affiliation scene without exhausting what the focus calls good things.

changed_reading.before: The law-and-path pair denotes parallel legal systems, while good deeds remains an abstract category.
changed_reading.after: Each route is traversed through visible practices such as worship, purifying transfer, humility, and exertion; goods are route-fruit, not merely a score.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ is an established anterior/proximity construction and should not be replaced by a literal hand reading. It remains anchored because the exact hand root recurs through restraint, violence, penalty, and the confirmation formula in this packet, while the split mapped root also carries protective support. Downstream prose should present juridical agency only as a secondary resonance, never as the base translation.

activation_trace.role: What stands between the hands supplies the primary sense of prior material immediately before the new Book.
The split mapping's protective support makes supervised proximity a live but form-distant resonance.
Opposed bodily hands enact attack and restraint, charging hand proximity with responsibility.
The hand as bodily agent becomes directly answerable within the legal sequence.
The repeated confirmation formula establishes immediate anterior scripture as a deliberate local relation.

changed_reading.before: The prior Book is only temporally anterior to the focus Book.
changed_reading.after: While remaining anterior, it also stands as proximate evidence at hand within a pericope where hands repeatedly enact, withhold, and answer for legal action.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a distant compositional activation rather than a necessary structure. It remains valid because the pericope opens with a consequential report presented with truth and the focus closes with God's future report about divergent paths, all anchored in the same report root and the focus return. Downstream prose should call it a possible narrative frame, not a proven chiasm.

activation_trace.role: A consequential transmitted report opens the context with an adjudicative human conflict.
The future consequential report supplies the authoritative ending of unresolved difference.
Return to the origin locates when the closing report becomes available.
Different paths provide the dispute whose complete account is deferred.

changed_reading.before: The final informing is a generic notice of later judgment.
changed_reading.after: It may close a report-frame begun by the two sons: current legal difference is a still-unfinished conflict whose authoritative narration belongs to God at return.

strongest_changes: Muhaymin shifted from bare dominance to accountable preservation-and-witness custody.
Judgment became a life-protecting, deterrent, balanced, and repair-opening restraint.
Assigned communal plurality became a bounded assay rather than either forced sameness or indiscriminate equivalence.
The race toward goods became a redirection of fear-driven rushing, not competition for communal supremacy.
summary.what_was_special: The packet made relational position unusually productive: words can be moved from their places, truth can fit its joint, revelation can restore placement, and oversight can guard the arrangement. The flanking speed scenes and the acceptance/partial-deflection frame also changed how plurality and racing function.
remaining_uncertainties: Muhaymin may carry a more asymmetrical sovereign-criterion force than the custody model foregrounds.
The rein, fitted-joint, and hand resonances are functional activations, not replacement translations.
The post-focus practice cluster may exemplify good things without defining their full scope.
